question: What causal condition allows the speaker to come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching in the presence of its lord?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of the Kaulas.
Knowledge arises only by the grace of that lord.
By that grace the speaker has come to know the Kaula determination.
inference: By the grace of the lord of the Kaulas, the speaker has come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching.
uncertainties: Prior state of ignorance not specified
plain_english: By your grace, O lord of the Kaulas, I have come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching.
